sources.title: 關於燁鋒 - 燁鋒輕合金
sources.effective_period: Current page retrieved 2026-10-06; page has no publication/update date
sources.locator: HTML JSON-LD WebPage.description; the Asian-only statement was not present in the visible body text
sources.note: The official Chinese page metadata states that Ye Fong is the only Asian aluminum-alloy mill with full-process capability for aerospace-grade plate, tube, bar, and hot-rolled wire rod. This is an issuer self-description, not independent comparative evidence.

sources.title: Ye Fong Aluminium | Aluminum Alloy Wire/Rod, Bar, Tube, Plate mill in Taiwan
sources.effective_period: Current page retrieved 2026-10-06; footer copyright 2020, no page update date
sources.locator: Visible page text, manufacturing overview and 'Why Ye Fong' section
sources.note: The page lists aerospace aluminum product forms and manufacturing processes. Its 'Why Ye Fong' text says 'one of few' mills in Taiwan have the listed full-process capability, which does not corroborate the Chinese metadata's 'only in Asia' wording.

sources.title: 產品應用實績＆市場 - 燁鋒輕合金
sources.effective_period: Current page retrieved 2026-10-06; page has no publication/update date
sources.locator: Visible body, 航太 section and fastener section
sources.note: The issuer lists aerospace-use seamless tubes, bars, and hot-rolled plates, including aircraft seat, hydraulic, fastener, structural, and other applications; it separately lists hot-rolled wire rod for aerospace and automotive fasteners.

sources.title: 臺灣航太產業 A-Team 4.0 原物料商締結聯盟
sources.note: AIDC lists 燁鋒 among six raw-material suppliers signing the A-Team 4.0 aerospace strategic alliance; the report says it would be a supplier alliance and did not establish an Asia-wide uniqueness ranking.

search_notes: Targeted searches for an independent Asia-wide comparison found the issuer's Chinese uniqueness statement repeated in secondary profiles, but no independent market census or comparator supporting the full uniqueness scope.

A separate official issuer English page uses the narrower wording 'one of few' for full-process capability in Taiwan. This is recorded as a source-scope inconsistency, not treated as a conclusive disproof of the broader regional claim.
